emerging_technology: Indoor autonomous delivery robots: wheeled service robots that navigate indoor routes to carry meals or items to destinations
intended_application: Deliver towels and sealed guest supplies from a service station to guest-floor handoff points, potentially using elevators; staff load items and support guests.
business_need: Reduce staff trips for routine guest supplies without reducing service accessibility.
users_stakeholders: Hotel staff, guests, front-desk managers, facilities personnel and the elevator service provider.
capabilities_constraints: Hypothetical assumptions: multiple guest floors and staffed service desk; elevator integration, door access, secure compartments, connectivity, guest handoff and recovery remain unverified. A FlashBot-type building delivery configuration would be assessed; a restaurant tray robot is not assumed to use elevators.
risk_consequence_context: Blocked circulation, elevator conflicts, wrong-room delivery, lost items, failed access and guest privacy or accessibility problems.
management_question: Should the hotel launch multi-floor robot supply delivery now, or stage integration checks first?
time_horizon: Six-week feasibility and integration assessment before any guest-floor service; annual significance review over three years.
additional_context: Evidence snapshot 2026-10-22. All venue details are hypothetical assumptions, not observations at a named company.
